report.clinical_summary: Patient with Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia diagnosed a year ago, on ibrutinib therapy with good hematologic response (lymphocyte count significantly down). Still experiences fatigue (rated 5/10), frequent infections, lymphadenopathy, and concerning easy bruising (appears suddenly, takes long to heal, sometimes painful). Also reports increased thirst and dizziness. Patient is compliant with oncologist's care plan, makes practical adjustments to manage energy (taking breaks, pacing), and actively follows up on concerns. Trusts oncologist and sees treatment as beneficial.
